# sprint scrums links resolve-text

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint scrums links resolve-text — Explicit issue UUID/ticket aliases and sprint IDs use an independent link revision from list. Set replaces only links; resolve-text previews exact references. No issue state or 4DX measurement is inferred.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint scrums links resolve-text --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Explicit issue UUID/ticket aliases and sprint IDs use an independent link revision from list. Set replaces only links; resolve-text previews exact references. No issue state or 4DX measurement is inferred.

EXAMPLES
  sprint scrums links resolve-text --file input.json

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  None; see SYNOPSIS for required input flags.

FLAGS
  --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output data or records + meta on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  Sprint profile or automation-token file required. Server permissions are authoritative.

NOTES
  Examples use placeholder IDs and files; replace them with authorized current values.
  API action: executionLinks.scrum.resolveText
  JSON input for --json-data/--file: {"type":"object","properties":{"resource":{"const":"scrum","type":"string"},"id":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":500},"text":{"type":"string","maxLength":20000}},"required":["resource","id","text"],"additionalProperties":false}
```
